hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && dotnet build MyVocaList.sln --no-restore -v q 2>&1 | tail -40

echo 'CONTEXT RESTORED — Non-negotiables: (1) dotnet build after every change, fix all errors before next file. (2) Never use DisplayAlert/DisplayActionSheet/DisplayPromptAsync. (3) DevExpress-first — check devexpress-patterns.md before any UI work. (4) SafeAreaEdges=Container on all ContentPages (.NET MAUI 10). (5) Spec → Plan → Implement → Review — never skip to implementation. (6) English only in code, comments, logs, UI text. (7) After every completed task: /project:review → /project:commit (stage, commit, push).'

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && STATUS=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null) && if [ -n "$STATUS" ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ Uncommitted changes detected — run /project:commit to complete the task."}'; fi
